fields.title: XML column
fields.description: The column containing the XML cells.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove source column
fields.description: When checked, the source column will be removed.

fields.title: Output columns
fields.description: Configure the XPaths used to extract data from the input column.

fields.title: Namespaces
fields.description:
The prefixes and the namespaces used in the XPath query. For example when querying XHTML documents with the XPath Query:
//pre:h1
the following namespace must be defined:
Prefix: pre
Namespace: http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml
Note: The namespaces are collected automatically.

fields.title: Incorporate namespace of the root element
fields.description:
This option is useful when you do not have the default namespace of your document at hand.

If checked, the namespace of the root element is added to the Namespaces table during runtime.

fields.title: Prefix of root's namespace
fields.description:
Define a prefix for the root namespace in case it is incorporated.

For the example of XHTML documents the namespace of the root element is http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml so that with the root's prefix of pre you can leavethe Namespaces table empty.
